message: In the ground-level cooperative loading workflow (C5), Sam, the fifty-crate manual handling has back-injury risk if crate weight exceeds safe limits. To check it I used hand calculation (the 1000 kg total mass check (E7)) reusing the crate net volume calculation (E5). I found 1000 kg total as fifty 20 kg crates within single-person capacity, according to National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH, National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health), 1993. I propose capped 20 kg vented crates with ground-level door and central aisle shown in the cooperative loading workflow sketch (E8). My position: not ready because cleaning and ownership proof is still open. In the ground-level cooperative loading workflow (C5), Maya, the reusable crates and shared room has decay spread and neglected maintenance risk. To check it I used field practice review with the layout (the cooperative loading workflow sketch (E8)). I found daily chlorinated-water washing prevents cross-lot decay, according to Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO, Food and Agriculture Organization), 1989. I propose external wash slab plus pay-per-crate cooperative ownership with trained local caretaker, according to Oorja Development Solutions, 2023. My position: not ready because compressor-battery closure by others is still open.
